diagnosis: The check C1 passed in all rollouts because the model defaulted to scheduling a 'video' follow-up on the 'same_week' day, which aligns with PF2. This default setting allowed the check to pass even though PF2 was never accessed by the lone decision-maker.

C1.why: PF2 changes the actual schedulable option from a generic same-week follow-up to one specific workable slot, making Friday at 2:00 p.m. by video the only same-week arrangement and creating the need to send video instructions.

fix_instructions: Tighten check C1 to ensure it depends on PF2. Specifically, update the check such that it requires the decision-maker to explicitly choose between 'in_person' and 'video' formats, and to specify the exact day for the follow-up if choosing 'same_week'. This will prevent the model from defaulting to a specific format and day without considering PF2.
